---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

(***************************************************************************)
(* Basic cardinality bounds for small explicitly-listed sets.              *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA HR_CardTwo ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b
  PROVE  IsFiniteSet({a, b}) /\ Cardinality({a, b}) <= 2
PROOF
<1>1. IsFiniteSet({b}) /\ Cardinality({b}) = 1
  BY SMTT("r30"), FS_Singleton
<1>2. {a, b} = {b} \cup {a}
  BY SMTT("r30")
<1>3. IsFiniteSet({b} \cup {a})
      /\ Cardinality({b} \cup {a}) = IF a \in {b} THEN Cardinality({b}) ELSE Cardinality({b}) + 1
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, FS_AddElement
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA HR_CardThree ==
  ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, NEW c
  PROVE  IsFiniteSet({a, b, c}) /\ Cardinality({a, b, c}) <= 3
PROOF
<1>1. IsFiniteSet({b, c}) /\ Cardinality({b, c}) <= 2
  BY SMTT("r30"), HR_CardTwo
<1>2. {a, b, c} = {b, c} \cup {a}
  BY SMTT("r30")
<1>3. IsFiniteSet({b, c} \cup {a})
      /\ Cardinality({b, c} \cup {a}) =
           IF a \in {b, c} THEN Cardinality({b, c}) ELSE Cardinality({b, c}) + 1
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, FS_AddElement
<1>4. Cardinality({b, c}) \in Nat
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, FS_CardinalityType
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA HR_RolesDistinct ==
  /\ Follower # Candidate
  /\ Follower # Leader
  /\ Candidate # Leader
PROOF
<1>1. CASE Follower = Candidate
  <2>1. {Follower, Candidate, Leader} = {Candidate, Leader}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, HR_CardTwo, RoleDomain
<1>2. CASE Follower = Leader
  <2>1. {Follower, Candidate, Leader} = {Candidate, Leader}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, HR_CardTwo, RoleDomain
<1>3. CASE Candidate = Leader
  <2>1. {Follower, Candidate, Leader} = {Follower, Leader}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, HR_CardTwo, RoleDomain
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA HR_MsgTypesDistinct ==
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # RequestVoteResponse
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesRequest
  /\ RequestVoteResponse # AppendEntriesResponse
  /\ AppendEntriesRequest # AppendEntriesResponse
PROOF
<1> DEFINE A == RequestVoteRequest
           B == RequestVoteResponse
           C == AppendEntriesRequest
           D == AppendEntriesResponse
<1>0. Cardinality({A, B, C, D}) = 4
  BY SMTT("r30"), MessageDomain
<1>1. CASE A = B
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {B, C, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1>2. CASE A = C
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {B, C, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1>3. CASE A = D
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {B, C, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1>4. CASE B = C
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {A, C, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>4
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1>5. CASE B = D
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {A, C, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>5
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1>6. CASE C = D
  <2>1. {A, B, C, D} = {A, B, D}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>6
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>0, HR_CardThree
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6

(***************************************************************************)
(* Every finite non-empty set of integers has a maximum element, hence     *)
(* SetMax picks it.                                                        *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA HR_MaxExists ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S \subseteq Int, S # {}
  PROVE  \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
PROOF
<1> DEFINE P(T) == (T = {}) \/ (\E z \in T : \A y \in T : z >= y)
<1>1. P({})
  BY SMTT("r30")
<1>2. ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW x \in S \ T
      PROVE  P(T \cup {x})
  <2> USE IsFiniteSet(T), P(T)
  <2>0. (T = {}) \/ (\E z \in T : \A y \in T : z >= y)
    BY SMTT("r30")
  <2>1. x \in Int
    BY SMTT("r30")
  <2> SUFFICES \E z \in T \cup {x} : \A y \in T \cup {x} : z >= y
    BY SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. CASE T = {}
    <3>1. T \cup {x} = {x}
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>2
    <3> WITNESS x \in T \cup {x}
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <2>1
  <2>3. CASE T # {}
    <3>1. PICK z \in T : \A y \in T : z >= y
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>0, <2>3
    <3>2. z \in Int
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1
    <3>3. CASE x >= z
      <4> WITNESS x \in T \cup {x}
      <4>1. \A y \in T : x >= y
        BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <3>2, <2>1, <3>3
      <4> QED
        BY SMTT("r30"), <4>1, <2>1
    <3>4. CASE ~(x >= z)
      <4> WITNESS z \in T \cup {x}
      <4>1. z >= x
        BY SMTT("r30"), <3>2, <2>1, <3>4
      <4> QED
        BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <4>1
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>3, <3>4
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>2, <2>3
<1> HIDE DEF P
<1>3. P(S)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, FS_Induction, IsaM("blast")
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3 DEF P

LEMMA HR_SetMaxProp ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S \subseteq Int, S # {}
  PROVE  /\ SetMax(S) \in S
         /\ \A y \in S : SetMax(S) >= y
PROOF
<1>1. \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
  BY SMTT("r30"), HR_MaxExists
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1 DEF SetMax

LEMMA HR_IntervalFinite ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int, NEW S, S \subseteq a..b
  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(S)
PROOF
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(a..b)
  BY SMTT("r30"), FS_Interval
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, FS_Subset

LEMMA HR_SetMaxIdx ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW S, S \subseteq 0..n, S # {}
  PROVE  /\ SetMax(S) \in S
         /\ \A y \in S : y <= SetMax(S)
PROOF
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY SMTT("r30"), HR_IntervalFinite
<1>2. S \subseteq Int
  BY SMTT("r30")
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, HR_SetMaxProp

(***************************************************************************)
(* Properties of the configuration-index operators on a sequence.          *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA HR_ConfigIdxProps ==
  ASSUME NEW ES, NEW L \in Seq(ES)
  PROVE  /\ ConfigIndices(L) \subseteq 1..Len(L)
         /\ LastConfigIndex(L) \in 0..Len(L)
         /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(L) : k <= LastConfigIndex(L)
         /\ (ConfigIndices(L) # {} => LastConfigIndex(L) \in ConfigIndices(L))
         /\ PreviousConfigIndex(L) \in 0..Len(L)
         /\ PreviousConfigIndex(L) <= LastConfigIndex(L)
         /\ \A k \in ConfigIndices(L) :
               (k # LastConfigIndex(L)) => k <= PreviousConfigIndex(L)
PROOF
<1> DEFINE CI == ConfigIndices(L)
<1> DEFINE OL == CI \ {LastConfigIndex(L)}
<1>n. Len(L) \in Nat
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>1. CI \subseteq 1..Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF ConfigIndices
<1>1a. CI \subseteq 0..Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>n
<1>o. OL \subseteq 0..Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1a
<1>2. CASE CI = {}
  <2>1. LastConfigIndex(L) = 0
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2 DEF LastConfigIndex
  <2>2. OL = {}
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2
  <2>3. PreviousConfigIndex(L) = 0
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>2, <2>1 DEF PreviousConfigIndex
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>n, <2>1, <2>3
<1>3. CASE CI # {}
  <2>1. LastConfigIndex(L) = SetMax(CI)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3 DEF LastConfigIndex
  <2>2. SetMax(CI) \in CI /\ \A y \in CI : y <= SetMax(CI)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1a, <1>3, <1>n, HR_SetMaxIdx
  <2>3. LastConfigIndex(L) \in 0..Len(L)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <2>2, <1>1
  <2>4. \A k \in CI : k <= LastConfigIndex(L)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <2>2
  <2>5. CASE OL = {}
    <3>1. PreviousConfigIndex(L) = 0
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>5 DEF PreviousConfigIndex
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <2>3, <2>4, <2>2, <1>1, <1>n, <2>5
  <2>6. CASE OL # {}
    <3>1. PreviousConfigIndex(L) = SetMax(OL)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>6 DEF PreviousConfigIndex
    <3>2. SetMax(OL) \in OL /\ \A y \in OL : y <= SetMax(OL)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <1>o, <2>6, <1>n, HR_SetMaxIdx
    <3>3. PreviousConfigIndex(L) \in 0..Len(L)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <3>2, <1>1
    <3>4. PreviousConfigIndex(L) <= LastConfigIndex(L)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <3>2, <2>4
    <3>5. \A k \in CI : (k # LastConfigIndex(L)) => k <= PreviousConfigIndex(L)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <3>2
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>5, <2>6
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2, <1>3

(***************************************************************************)
(* The set of well-formed log entries.                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
HR_Entry == [term : Nat, type : {ValueEntry, ConfigEntry},
             config : SUBSET Server, value : Values \cup {Nil}]

LEMMA HR_EntryField ==
  ASSUME NEW L \in Seq(HR_Entry), NEW k \in 1..Len(L)
  PROVE  /\ L[k] \in HR_Entry
         /\ L[k].term \in Nat
         /\ L[k].config \in SUBSET Server
PROOF
<1>1. L[k] \in HR_Entry
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1 DEF HR_Entry

LEMMA HR_ConfigAtType ==
  ASSUME NEW L \in Seq(HR_Entry), NEW k \in 0..Len(L)
  PROVE  ConfigAt(L, k) \in SUBSET Server
PROOF
<1>1. CASE k = 0
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1 DEF ConfigAt
<1>2. CASE k # 0
  <2>1. k \in 1..Len(L)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2
  <2>2. L[k].config \in SUBSET Server
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, HR_EntryField
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2, <2>2 DEF ConfigAt
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA HR_LatestConfigInType ==
  ASSUME NEW L \in Seq(HR_Entry), NEW k \in Nat
  PROVE  LatestConfigIn(L, k) \in SUBSET Server
PROOF
<1>n. Len(L) \in Nat
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1> DEFINE bnd == Min(k, Len(L))
<1> DEFINE IDX == {j \in 1..bnd : L[j].type = ConfigEntry}
<1>1. bnd \in Nat /\ bnd <= Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>n DEF Min
<1>2. IDX \subseteq 1..Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1
<1>2a. IDX \subseteq 0..Len(L)
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2, <1>n
<1>3. LatestConfigIn(L, k) = IF IDX = {} THEN Server ELSE L[SetMax(IDX)].config
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF LatestConfigIn
<1>4. CASE IDX = {}
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3, <1>4
<1>5. CASE IDX # {}
  <2>1. SetMax(IDX) \in IDX
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>2a, <1>5, <1>n, HR_SetMaxIdx
  <2>2. L[SetMax(IDX)].config \in SUBSET Server
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>2, HR_EntryField
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3, <1>5, <2>2
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>4, <1>5

LEMMA HR_SubSeqType ==
  ASSUME NEW ES, NEW s, NEW m \in Int, NEW n \in Int,
         \A i \in m..n : s[i] \in ES
  PROVE  /\ SubSeq(s, m, n) \in Seq(ES)
         /\ Len(SubSeq(s, m, n)) = IF m <= n THEN n - m + 1 ELSE 0
PROOF
<1>1. /\ SubSeq(s, m, n) \in Seq(ES)
      /\ Len(SubSeq(s, m, n)) = IF m <= n THEN n - m + 1 ELSE 0
      /\ \A i \in 1 .. n-m+1 : SubSeq(s, m, n)[i] = s[m+i-1]
  BY \A i \in m..n : s[i] \in ES, SubSeqProperties
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1

LEMMA HR_PrefixType ==
  ASSUME NEW ES, NEW s \in Seq(ES), NEW q \in 0..Len(s)
  PROVE  /\ SubSeq(s, 1, q) \in Seq(ES)
         /\ Len(SubSeq(s, 1, q)) = q
PROOF
<1>n. Len(s) \in Nat /\ s \in [1..Len(s) -> ES]
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>1. \A i \in 1..q : s[i] \in ES
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>n
<1>2. /\ 1 \in Int
      /\ q \in Int
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>n
<1>3. /\ SubSeq(s, 1, q) \in Seq(ES)
      /\ Len(SubSeq(s, 1, q)) = IF 1 <= q THEN q - 1 + 1 ELSE 0
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1, <1>2, HR_SubSeqType
<1> QED
  BY SMTT("r30"), <1>3, <1>n

(***************************************************************************)
(* MergeEntries produces a well-formed log that covers prevIdx + |entries|.*)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA HR_MergeType ==
  ASSUME NEW L \in Seq(HR_Entry), NEW E \in Seq(HR_Entry),
         NEW p \in Nat, p <= Len(L)
  PROVE  /\ MergeEntries(L, p, E) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
         /\ Len(MergeEntries(L, p, E)) >= p + Len(E)
PROOF
<1>nl. Len(L) \in Nat
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>ne. Len(E) \in Nat
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>1. CASE Len(E) = 0
  <2>1. MergeEntries(L, p, E) = L
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>1 DEF MergeEntries
  <2> QED
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>1, <1>nl
<1>lf. L \in [1..Len(L) -> HR_Entry]
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>ef. E \in [1..Len(E) -> HR_Entry]
  BY SMTT("r30"), LenProperties
<1>2. CASE Len(E) # 0
  <2> DEFINE fN == CHOOSE k \in 1..(Len(E) + 1) :
                     /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                          /\ p + j <= Len(L)
                          /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
                     /\ \/ k = Len(E) + 1
                        \/ p + k > Len(L)
                        \/ L[p + k].term /= E[k].term
  <2> DEFINE A == {k \in 0..Len(E) :
                     \A j \in 1..k : p + j <= Len(L) /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term}
  <2>1. 0 \in A /\ A \subseteq 0..Len(E)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <1>ne
  <2>2. SetMax(A) \in A /\ \A y \in A : y <= SetMax(A)
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>1, <1>ne, HR_SetMaxIdx
  <2>3. PICK aa \in 0..Len(E) :
              /\ \A j \in 1..aa : p + j <= Len(L) /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
              /\ \A y \in A : y <= aa
    BY <2>2, <2>1
  <2>4. \/ aa = Len(E)
        \/ p + (aa + 1) > Len(L)
        \/ L[p + (aa + 1)].term /= E[aa + 1].term
    <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME aa # Len(E),
                          p + (aa + 1) <= Len(L),
                          L[p + (aa + 1)].term = E[aa + 1].term
                   PROVE  FALSE
      BY SMTT("r30")
    <3> USE aa # Len(E), p + (aa + 1) <= Len(L),
            L[p + (aa + 1)].term = E[aa + 1].term
    <3>2. aa + 1 \in 0..Len(E)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>3, <1>ne
    <3>3. \A j \in 1..(aa + 1) : p + j <= Len(L) /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>3, <1>ne
    <3>4. aa + 1 \in A
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>2, <3>3
    <3>5. aa + 1 <= aa
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>4, <2>3
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>5, <2>3, <1>ne
  <2>5. \E k \in 1..(Len(E) + 1) :
           /\ \A j \in 1..(k-1) :
                /\ p + j <= Len(L)
                /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
           /\ \/ k = Len(E) + 1
              \/ p + k > Len(L)
              \/ L[p + k].term /= E[k].term
    <3>1. aa + 1 \in 1..(Len(E) + 1)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>3, <1>ne
    <3> WITNESS aa + 1 \in 1..(Len(E) + 1)
    <3>2. \A j \in 1..(aa + 1 - 1) :
             p + j <= Len(L) /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>3, <1>ne
    <3>3. \/ aa + 1 = Len(E) + 1
          \/ p + (aa + 1) > Len(L)
          \/ L[p + (aa + 1)].term /= E[aa + 1].term
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>4, <1>ne, <2>3
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>2, <3>3
  <2>6. /\ fN \in 1..(Len(E) + 1)
        /\ \A j \in 1..(fN - 1) : p + j <= Len(L) /\ L[p + j].term = E[j].term
        /\ \/ fN = Len(E) + 1
           \/ p + fN > Len(L)
           \/ L[p + fN].term /= E[fN].term
    BY SMTT("r30"), <2>5
  <2>7. MergeEntries(L, p, E) =
          IF fN = Len(E) + 1 THEN L
          ELSE SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \o SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E))
    BY <1>2 DEF MergeEntries
  <2> HIDE DEF fN
  <2>8. CASE fN = Len(E) + 1
    <3>1. Len(E) \in 1..(fN - 1)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>8, <1>ne, <1>2
    <3>2. p + Len(E) <= Len(L)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <2>6
    <3> QED
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>7, <2>8, <3>2, <1>nl, <1>ne
  <2>9. CASE fN # Len(E) + 1
    <3>1. fN \in 1..Len(E)
      BY SMTT("r30"), <2>6, <2>9, <1>ne
    <3>2. p + fN - 1 \in 0..Len(L)
      <4>1. CASE fN = 1
        BY SMTT("r30"), <4>1, <1>nl
      <4>2. CASE fN # 1
        <5>1. fN - 1 \in 1..(fN - 1)
          BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <4>2, <1>ne
        <5>2. p + (fN - 1) <= Len(L)
          BY SMTT("r30"), <5>1, <2>6
        <5> QED
          BY SMTT("r30"), <5>2, <1>nl, <3>1, <1>ne
      <4> QED
        BY SMTT("r30"), <4>1, <4>2
    <3>3. SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
          /\ Len(SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1)) = p + fN - 1
      BY SMTT("r30"), <3>2, HR_PrefixType
    <3>4. SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
          /\ Len(SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E))) = Len(E) - fN + 1
      <4>1. \A i \in fN..Len(E) : E[i] \in HR_Entry
        BY SMTT("r30"), <1>ef, <3>1, <1>ne
      <4>2. /\ fN \in Int
            /\ Len(E) \in Int
        BY SMTT("r30"), <3>1, <1>ne
      <4>3. SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
            /\ Len(SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)))
                 = IF fN <= Len(E) THEN Len(E) - fN + 1 ELSE 0
        BY SMTT("r30"), <4>1, <4>2, HR_SubSeqType
      <4> QED
        BY SMTT("r30"), <4>3, <3>1, <1>ne
    <3>5. SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \o SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
          /\ Len(SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \o SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E))) = p + Len(E)
      <4>1. /\ SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \o SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)) \in Seq(HR_Entry)
            /\ Len(SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1) \o SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)))
                 = Len(SubSeq(L, 1, p + fN - 1)) + Len(SubSeq(E, fN, Len(E)))
        BY SMTT("r30"), <3>3, <3>4, ConcatProperties
      <4> QED
